mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (alert_type, level, title, body, dedupe_key) SELECT #{alertType}, #{level}, #{title}, #{body}, #{dedupeKey} WHERE #{dedupeKey}::text IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')
mapper.sql: n.id, n.alert_type, n.level, n.title, n.body, n.status, n.created_at, n.sent_at, (SELECT string_agg(d.target || ':' || d.status, '|' ORDER BY d.id) FROM notification_delivery d WHERE d.notification_id = n.id) AS deliveries
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification n WHERE n.status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_delivery d WHERE d.notification_id = n.id) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: id, name, kind, webhook_url, array_to_string(alert_types, '|') AS alert_types, enabled, updated_by, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notify_channel WHERE enabled AND #{alertType} = ANY (alert_types) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, login_id, name, email, array_to_string(mail_alerts, '|') AS mail_alerts FROM admin_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND email IS NOT NULL AND email <> '' AND #{alertType} = ANY (mail_alerts) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_delivery (notification_id, channel_id, target) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{channelId}, #{target})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.notification_id, d.target, d.attempts, c.kind AS channel_kind, c.webhook_url, n.alert_type, n.level, n.title, n.body FROM notification_delivery d JOIN notification n ON n.id = d.notification_id LEFT JOIN notify_channel c ON c.id = d.channel_id WHERE d.status = 'PENDING' AND d.next_try_at <= now() ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = 'SENT', attempts = attempts + 1, sent_at = now(), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE notification_delivery SET attempts = #{attempts}, last_error = left(#{error}, 500), status = CASE WHEN #{giveUp} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_try_at = now() + make_interval(mins => #{retryMinutes}) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE notification n SET status = CASE WHEN s.failed = 0 THEN 'SENT' WHEN s.sent = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, sent_at = now() FROM (SELECT notification_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT') AS sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending FROM notification_delivery GROUP BY notification_id) s WHERE s.notification_id = n.id AND n.status = 'PENDING' AND s.pending = 0
mapper.select: SELECT status AS key, status AS label, count(*) AS count FROM crawl_item WHERE (status = 'REVIEW_PENDING' AND created_at < #{before}) OR (status = 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' AND reviewed_at < #{before}) GROUP BY status

SELECT p.partner_code, pt.name AS partner_name, max(p.last_collected_on) AS last_collected_on FROM plan p JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = p.partner_code WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND pt.exposed GROUP BY p.partner_code, pt.name, pt.sort_order ORDER BY pt.sort_order

SELECT pt.name AS partner_name, r.url_type, r.result, r.collected_count, r.new_count, r.changed_count, r.ended_count FROM crawl_run r JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = r.partner_code WHERE r.run_on = #{runOn} AND r.id = (SELECT max(x.id) FROM crawl_run x WHERE x.partner_code = r.partner_code AND x.url_type = r.url_type AND x.run_on = r.run_on) ORDER BY pt.sort_order, CASE r.url_type WHEN 'POSTPAID' THEN 1 WHEN 'PREPAID' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
SELECT FROM notify_channel ORDER BY id

INSERT INTO notify_channel (name, kind, webhook_url, alert_types, enabled, updated_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{kind}, #{webhookUrl}, #{alertTypes,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{enabled}, #{by}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_channel SET name = #{name}, kind = #{kind}, webhook_url = #{webhookUrl}, alert_types = #{alertTypes,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, name, email, array_to_string(mail_alerts, '|') AS mail_alerts FROM admin_user WHERE id = #{adminId}
SELECT FROM notification n ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
